rows.definition: The Objective-C @autoreleasepool scope used in darwin Metal sources to bound ARC temporary allocations around kernel dispatch.
rows.distinction: A language-level memory-scoping directive embedded in ObjC/Metal code; it allocates nothing and is not any fak buffer pool, slot pool, or pool profile.

rows.definition: The macobs headroom-snapshot field reporting how many bytes of unified-memory KV pool remain available for concurrent agent sessions.
rows.distinction: An observed host-fit telemetry value about remaining capacity; it neither declares a placement pool nor reports a pool's usable-bytes input like fitplan's PoolUsableBytes.

rows.definition: The v41DeviceGatherOps field holding the bound V4.1 gated-compressor-pool seam for device gather operations.
rows.distinction: A holder field on the gather-ops struct; it stores the v41CompressorPoolFunc value exposed by the compressorPoolFunc() accessor rather than being the func type or the accessor itself.

rows.definition: The v41DeviceGatherOps accessor method returning the bound gated-pool seam, nil under device-only when the backend exposes no V4.1 compressor pool.
rows.distinction: An accessor method on the gather-ops struct; it returns the v41CompressorPoolFunc value held in the compressorPool field and is not the func type itself.

rows.definition: The Strix Halo Vulkan residency ablation arm name for direct device-local allocation (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT mapped into APU GTT) versus host-visible streaming.
rows.distinction: A named benchmark ablation arm measuring residency latency; it is not a runtime pool container, allocator, or sizing knob.

rows.definition: The gateway Config field selecting bounded learned CPU causal embedding pooling mode ('mean' or 'last'); empty leaves the hash default unchanged.
rows.distinction: A text-embedding aggregation mode over hidden states; 'pooling' here means mean/last-token reduction, not a memory pool or pool profile.

rows.definition: The package-local sentinel error returned when a KV or page pool binding is nil, defined separately as kvmmu.ErrNilPool and radixkv.ErrNilPool.
rows.distinction: A nil-input guard sentinel on pool bindings; it is not the observer-pool lifecycle sentinels ErrPoolClosed or ErrPoolStopped.

rows.definition: The environment opt-out (=0) that disables per-shape recycling of dead intermediate projection/norm buffers in Qwen3.5 whole-token Metal prefill graphs, restoring fresh allocations for rollback or A/B measurement.
rows.distinction: An env-var toggle for the graph buffer-recycle pool; it enables SetBufferPool(8) on the whole-token graph and is not the SetBufferPool API itself or the C entry point behind it.

rows.definition: The extern-C CUDA kernel entry point implementing the DeepSeek V4.1 gated compressor pool in binary32, cgo-bound by the compute package's live and pending compressor bindings.
rows.distinction: A device kernel symbol for one backend implementation; it is not the V41CompressorPoolBackend interface that declares the host-facing pool contract.

rows.definition: The GLM5-next spine config field (json index_kpool, default 4) fixing the indexer K-pool slot count for hybrid sparse-attention admission.
rows.distinction: A model-config scalar naming a key-slot budget; it is not a memory pool container and not the external K-pool tail patch script cited in the GLM-5.3 study.

rows.definition: The Strix Halo constant bounding GTT physical allocations at 116 GiB on 128 GiB DRAM, enforced by the KFD and UMA allocators.
rows.distinction: A hardware allocation-ceiling constant; it caps individual allocations rather than sizing a reusable buffer pool or a worktree pool cap.

rows.definition: The Metal engine C entry point enabling the per-shape idle-buffer recycle pool at a given maximum idle depth, implemented in q4k.m.
rows.distinction: The C/Metal side of the graph buffer pool; the Go ProjectionGraph.SetBufferPool method wraps it and adds the opt-in pre-first-encode guard.

rows.definition: The constructor creating and starting a persistent NUMA-pinned decode worker pool from a DecodeNUMASchedule.
rows.distinction: A factory function; it builds the NUMADecodePool type and is not the pool state referenced by model fields.

rows.definition: The constructor building a host V41CompressorPool for a validated ratio/width, the entry point of the DeepSeek V4.1 gated compressor pool group.
rows.distinction: A factory for the host pool type; it is not the device-backend interface, its argument validator, or the checked cudaV41CompressorPool operator.

rows.definition: The compute package type managing a set of pinned decode workers distributed across NUMA nodes for barrier-free bit-identical decode.
rows.distinction: The worker-pool type itself; it is not its constructor NewNUMADecodePool nor the model-state field numaPool that references an instance of it.

rows.definition: The model-state field (*compute.NUMADecodePool) shared by quantized heads so decode reads each replica from its own NUMA node.
rows.distinction: A reference field on model state; it points at a NUMADecodePool instance and is not the pool type or its constructor.

rows.definition: The upstream vLLM patch script (patch_kpool_tail_positions.py) cited in the GLM-5.3 EXL3 concept study that restores positions= in hybrid-model state for the K-pool tail cache.
rows.distinction: An external upstream bugfix script referenced in study notes; it is not a fak pool container, config field, or the GLM5-next IndexKPool slot count.

rows.definition: The fitplan placement-report entry recording one physical memory pool's ID, usable bytes, and fit status against summed rank demand.
rows.distinction: A report-side demand record; it consumes the MemoryPool capacity declaration and differs from PoolUsableBytes, which reports the capacity value alone.

rows.definition: The L3 server client-stats counter of pool rebuilds, exported as the l3_client_pool_rebuilds gauge.
rows.distinction: A rebuild-event counter; it counts pool reconstruction events rather than reporting the current pool size measured by PoolSize.

rows.definition: The contextsizer flag reporting that the device aperture and host window are one physical DRAM pool on an integrated/APU tier, switching discrete-vs-shared sizing rules.
rows.distinction: A topology predicate on the memory plan; it is not the serveSharedPoolSizingFit helper that computes the host-window ceiling when it is true.

rows.definition: The L3 server client-stats gauge of the current client pool size, exported as l3_client_pool_size.
rows.distinction: A current-size gauge; it measures pool occupancy rather than counting rebuild events recorded by PoolRebuilds.

rows.definition: The harnessbench thundering-herd receipt field recording the witness pool's worker count used for the burst.
rows.distinction: A receipt measurement of configured concurrency; it is not the lease-accounting map leaseWorkersByPool that tracks per-pool leased workers.

rows.definition: The cmd/fak helper computing the host-window memory ceiling the context auto-sizer must size against when PoolSharedWithHost makes the KV store compete with co-resident weights for one physical pool.
rows.distinction: A sizing-budget substitution for shared-pool boxes; it consumes the PoolSharedWithHost predicate and is not that predicate or a generic pool container.

rows.definition: The ProjectionGraph method enabling the per-shape idle-buffer recycle pool at a maximum idle depth, opt-in before the first encode, so intermediate results are recycled through Release instead of fresh Metal allocations.
rows.distinction: The Go opt-in API on the graph; it wraps the C entry point mg_graph_set_buffer_pool and is toggled for whole-token prefill by the FAK_QWEN35_WHOLE_TOKEN_POOL env var.

rows.definition: The metalgemm expert-stream manager of preallocated reusable buffers with LRU eviction and lease lifecycles for queued expert loads.
rows.distinction: A private expert-load buffer pool inside metalgemm; it is not the MultiTensorSlotPool sized against device VRAM by NewMultiTensorSlotPoolForDevice, nor the ci-coverage seatpool identifier.

rows.definition: The transient PagedKVPool local in the native prefill/decode-disaggregation path that converts the prefill session cache into paged form for transfer.
rows.distinction: A short-lived local conversion pool on the PD wire path; it instantiates the general PagedKVPool type and is not that type's long-lived serving instances.

rows.definition: The comment term naming the fresh-allocation regime without buffer-pool recycling, used in the shellpool cost analysis (unpooled cost is TasksRun) and the Qwen3.5 pooled/unpooled graph parity claim.
rows.distinction: An allocation-mode adjective contrasting with pooled recycling; it names the absence of a pool rather than any pool container or its enabler SetBufferPool.

rows.definition: The DeepSeek V4.1 gated compressor pool: the host model.V41CompressorPool group-emission state and the same-named V41CompressorPoolBackend method transcribing its Push-group softmax gating for ratio >= 2.
rows.distinction: The pool concept itself across host state and device contract; it is not the checked cudaV41CompressorPool CUDA operator, its constructor, the backend interface, or the gather-ops field storing the seam.

rows.definition: The optional compute.Backend extension declaring SupportsV41CompressorPool and the device-side V41CompressorPool(kv, scores, ratio, width) gated-pool call.
rows.distinction: The capability interface a backend implements; it is not the pool concept it serves, the argument validator, or the Vulkan fail-closed error constructor.

rows.definition: The model-package func type owning one completed compressor group's gated pool call (layer, kv, scores, ratio, width -> pooled rows), the seam between host pool and device backend.
rows.distinction: A callable type; it is stored in the compressorPool field and returned by the compressorPoolFunc() accessor, and is not either of those struct members.

rows.definition: The pre-dispatch validator rejecting V4.1 compressor pool calls whose ratio/width fall outside the gated domain or whose operands are not unquantized row-major F32 [ratio,width] tensors.
rows.distinction: An argument-domain gate; it validates inputs to the V41CompressorPoolBackend call and is not the backend interface or the pool concept itself.

rows.definition: The Vulkan-specific fail-closed BackendError constructor tagging a failed dedicated compressor pool dispatch with Site V41CompressorPool.
rows.distinction: An error-construction helper for one backend's failure path; it reports a pool dispatch failure and is not the backend interface or the pool concept.
